reportMarkdown:
## Validation Summary
33 files created (XML, YAML, Java, SQL), 4/4 tasks completed — CODE_REVIEW gate failed with 5 findings; COMPILATION passed.

## Issues Detected

**[CRITICAL]** `Book.java` / `V1__schema.sql` — `totalCopies` field and `total_copies` column absent; only `availableCopies` present. Spec requires both. Root cause: `INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION`. Requires field addition to entity and schema migration.

**[CRITICAL]** `Member.java` / `V1__schema.sql` — `joinedAt` field and `joined_at` column not implemented. Root cause: `INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION`. Requires field addition to entity and schema migration.

**[CRITICAL]** `Loan.java` / `V1__schema.sql` — field named `loanDate` used instead of spec-required `loanedAt`; extra `dueDate` field present with no spec backing. Root cause: `INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION`. Requires rename and removal to align with spec contract.

**[MINOR]** Request DTOs (`CreateBookRequest.java`, `CreateMemberRequest.java`, `CheckoutLoanRequest.java`) — Bean Validation annotations (`@Valid`, `@NotBlank`, `@Email`) could not be confirmed by static analysis; files were outside key source scope. Root cause: `CONTEXT_EXHAUSTION`. Manual review required.

**[MINOR]** `GlobalExceptionHandler.java` — `problem+json` response shape (status, error, message) could not be verified; file exists but content was not reachable during review gate. Root cause: `CONTEXT_EXHAUSTION`. Manual review required.

**[RESOLVED]** `LoanRepository.findById` — lazy association access on `Book`/`Member` would cause `LazyInitializationException` at runtime. Eager fetching applied by review gate before merge.

## Checks Passed
COMPILATION (all 33 files), endpoint coverage (11/11 routes implemented), dependency wiring, Flyway migration file present, constructor injection verified

## Bottom Line
5 issues were caught and resolved or flagged by automated checks before merge, with 3 critical schema deviations requiring manual remediation prior to production deployment.
